title: Compression estimate: Hⁿ of the image of a set on which f is t²-close to a non-injective linear map
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), Hⁿ = μHE[n], Lⁿ = volume on ℝⁿ). Let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be any map, A : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P a continuous linear map that is not injective, S ⊆ ℝⁿ any set, and t ∈ ℝ≥0 with 0 < t ≤ 1. Assume ApproximatesLinearOn f A S (t²), i.e. |f(x) − f(x′) − A(x − x′)| ≤ t²|x − x′| for all x, x′ ∈ S. Then Hⁿ(f(S)) ≤ (‖A‖ + t)ⁿ · (t · Lⁿ(S)) in [0, ∞], where ‖A‖ is the operator norm.
